title: Roy Was in Smash Bros. Melee Before His Own Game Existed
hook:
Roy fought in Super Smash Bros. Melee on November 21, 2001, four months before Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade came out, because his original N64 game got cancelled. Who was your Melee main?
Gameplay is from Shards of Irsa, a game I'm making.
script: Did you know Roy from Fire Emblem was a Super Smash Bros. Melee fighter months before his own game existed? In nineteen ninety seven, Shigeru Miyamoto revealed a new Fire Emblem for the Nintendo Sixty Four disk drive add on. Inside Nintendo it was called Maiden of Darkness. Then the trouble started. Years went by with no release and not a single screenshot. In September of two thousand, Nintendo and Intelligent Systems said work on the Nintendo Sixty Four version had stopped. The project moved to the Game Boy Advance and became Fire Emblem The Binding Blade. Its hero, Roy, had been planned for the old version. Here is the strange part. The Binding Blade was supposed to come out before Melee, according to Smash director Masahiro Sakurai. Instead, Melee launched in Japan on November twenty first, two thousand one, with Roy already on the roster. His own game did not arrive in Japan until the following March, four months after Melee. So for a while, Roy was a guest star from a game nobody could buy. The Binding Blade never left Japan either. Only one screenshot of the cancelled version has ever been shown, in a book from twenty fifteen. Did you main Roy in Melee? Follow for more gaming history.
